# MLDecodedCrystallographicChirality

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A machine learning pipeline that learns to predict surface chirality directly from Fermi surface projections without explicit geometric labeling. This demonstrates how ML can extract hidden topological invariants from electronic structure, a capability transferable to in-network neuromorphic pattern recognition.
